name: Bumbuzz · Gremlet #20
description:
A round, fuzzy bumblebee whose wings are far too small. It flies anyway.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Bumbuzz in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
